title: ImportedStoneSource
description: Externally supplied stone geometry. `assetHash` is a content hash, never a filesystem path. `declaredUnit` is REQUIRED rather than inferred: no format JewelMind reads carries a reliable unit, and guessing one silently rescales a real physical object.

representation.description: Determined by PARSING the asset, never from its extension. A MESH carries no B-Rep topology and supports fewer operations.
